caption: Pro: after an edit, the columns line up when the cursor leaves the table, here in the monospace font.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const p=app.plugins.plugins['plain-text-tables']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('plain-text-tables-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); p.settings.align=true; p.settings.monospace=true; p.applySettings(); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.focus(); e.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); e.setCursor({line:5,ch:6}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); e.replaceRange(' and drinks', {line:5,ch:6}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); e.setCursor({line:8,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<30 && !e.getLine(2).startsWith('| Item ');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (!e.getLine(2).startsWith('| Item ')) throw new Error('not aligned: '+e.getLine(2)); e.setCursor({line:4,ch:3}); for (let i=0;i<50 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line.ptt-text-line').length<5;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line.ptt-text-line').length; if (n<5) throw new Error('text lines: '+n); return e.getValue(); })()
